_doc: Per-customer attribution facts we know by hand. Keyed by Summit customer id (sumitId) because several real customers share a display name. `name` is carried only as a human-readable comment. Anything set here is treated as high-confidence and wins over the rule engine. Leave `region` unset to let the CRM/phone resolver decide.
_todo: Schwarzkopf: only Henkel's own account is confirmed. The salons Henkel bought equipment for still need to be listed under channel `schwarzkopf` / campaign `henkel_schwarzkopf_il_2023`.
US masterclasses: the split between the New Jersey and Austin events is not known per customer, so all ten sit on the umbrella campaign.
